integrity: A complete analytic proof and an independently executable finite-check script are included. The counterexample is attributed to relevant prior literature. The potential for unlocated earlier deterministic Freiman-extension coverage is acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact noiseless real-valued uniqueness on an index-two Fourier coset only; no noise stability, algorithmic complexity, or fixed-group optimal threshold claimed.
title: Sharp one-third spectral-hole threshold for fourth-autocorrelation recovery
